mapper.sql: user_reward_id, user_id, reward_policy_id, stamp_id, pilgrimage_id, status, audit_score, audit_detail, granted_at, claimed_at, resolved_at, resolved_by

SELECT ur.user_reward_id, ur.user_id, u.nickname, ur.reward_policy_id, rp.name AS reward_name, rp.reward_type, ur.status, ur.stamp_id, ur.pilgrimage_id, c.name AS course_name, ur.granted_at AS earned_at, ur.claimed_at FROM user_reward ur JOIN users u ON u.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN reward_policy rp ON rp.reward_policy_id = ur.reward_policy_id LEFT JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = ur.pilgrimage_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_reward (user_id, reward_policy_id, stamp_id, pilgrimage_id, status, granted_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{rewardPolicyId}, #{stampId}, #{pilgrimageId}, 'GRANTED', NOW())
mapper.select: WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ur.granted_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reward SET status = #{status}, audit_score = #{auditScore}, audit_detail = #{auditDetail}, claimed_at = NOW(), resolved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PAID' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE user_reward_id = #{userRewardId} AND status = 'GRANTED'
